claims.A61: Bathos run provenance is keyed by a project_slug column, the runs table has no separate project id column, and the aminx slug holds more than 100 runs, so changing a slug after runs exist orphans them.

prereg.question: Is the slug the only project key on the bathos runs table, and how much provenance sits under aminx? (S20 measured the same thing but its claim text embedded a stale run count.)
prereg.expect_if_true: Rows show aminx with more than 100 runs; the column query returns exactly one column, project_slug.
prereg.expect_if_false: The column query returns an additional project id column (provenance could survive a slug change via the id, and the decide-the-slug-first ordering in S3-01 is unnecessary), or aminx has 100 runs or fewer. A bth failure is inconclusive: re-run under a new id.
